# Search Demand Reader

`search-demand-reader` · v1.0.0 · Diagnose · SEO, GEO & AEO
<!-- Generated by platform/scripts/generate-engine-specs.mjs from skills/search-demand-reader/spec.json and SKILL.md. Do not edit. -->

**Decision it supports:** Which topics are people already finding us for where better content would win more clicks?

**Inputs:** A Search Console Queries export (query, clicks, impressions, average position, and the page where available), your brand words, and optionally rival brand words

**Output:** Impressions and clicks by intent; topics grouped by their most common word with position and pages; the gaps you already appear for past position 10; queries split across two of your pages; the branded share of clicks; rival-brand searches you appear in; findings and a verdict naming the first topic to build or refresh

**Setup:**
- Install the skill: `npx skills add sarojkjha/aaj-marketing-skills --skill search-demand-reader`
- Or connect the hosted MCP server, no install: `https://aaj-engines-mcp.sarojkjha10.workers.dev/mcp`
- Or run the local MCP server: node platform/mcp/server.mjs (Node 18 or newer)
- Input schema: the comment at the top of `skills/search-demand-reader/resources/search-demand.js` (the MCP server's describe_engine shows it). Worked example: `node skills/search-demand-reader/resources/search-demand.js --demo`.
- Agents listed: Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, Windsurf, Cline. Tested and recorded: Claude Code, OpenAI Codex (Windows, ab-test-significance only).

**Acts or analyzes:** Analyzes only. The engine makes no network calls, writes no files and changes nothing in your tools; it returns text and JSON.

**Where your information goes:**

| How you run it | Where your inputs go |
|---|---|
| Skill installed in your agent, or the local MCP server | The engine runs on your machine and AAJ receives nothing. Your AI agent still sends what you give it to its model provider (Anthropic, OpenAI and so on), under your own account's terms. |
| Hosted MCP server | Your agent's model provider, as above, plus AAJ's server on Cloudflare, which receives the engine inputs over HTTPS, runs them in memory and keeps no copy. Cloudflare keeps error logs (no inputs) for up to 7 days. |

No engine needs customer names, emails or other personal data; leave them out.

**Limitations:**
- It sees only queries where your pages appeared. It cannot size a market or show demand you never appeared for, and impressions are not search volume.
- Topics group queries by their most common word. This is coarse on purpose; read the top queries under a topic before acting on it.
- Branded share depends on the brand words you list. Leave one out and branded searches are counted as non-branded demand.
- Cannibalisation needs the page for each query; without it none can be found. The 200-impression, position-10 and 20%-split cut-offs are this engine's rules.

**Review before acting:** The content or SEO lead checks the export covers at least three months and includes pages, confirms the brand and rival words, and reads each gap's top queries before briefing a page.

Method: [skills.aajconsult.com/skills/search-demand-reader](https://skills.aajconsult.com/skills/search-demand-reader)
